title: New Product Launch Video and Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Create product launch videos and photos from one product image: make a teaser, reveal, and listing asset before launch day, without a studio booking or reshoot.
h1: Create Your Product Launch Video and Photos Fast
lead: Make a teaser and a first-look scene from one product photo, before the launch date is public.

faq.q: How many credits does a launch photo or video use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Video uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see the cost before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I add a countdown to the launch video?
faq.a: No. The clip does not include a timer. Add the countdown in your editor or ad platform after download, where you can change the end time.

faq.q: Will anyone else see my unreleased product?
faq.a: No. The upload and the result stay in your account, and they are not published until you share them.

faq.q: What frame should a launch visual use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. For video, use 9:16 for Stories, Reels, and TikTok, 1:1 for a feed, 16:9 for a wide page, or 4:3 and 3:4 when the placement needs them. Each video is its own job.

faq.q: How long can the launch clip be?
faq.a: Clips run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Six seconds fits a quick reveal. Use 15 or 30 seconds when the launch needs a fuller product story.

faq.q: Can a generated presenter introduce the product?
faq.a: Yes, if you ask for a person in the scene. That presenter is generated, not a real customer. You can also keep the scene on the product alone.

faq.q: Can I change the launch date after the video is made?
faq.a: Yes. Add the date as text after download, so a new day does not mean a new scene.

faq.q: Can I run the clip as a paid launch ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. Platform ad rules still apply.

faq.q: Can I generate launch visuals for many products at once?
faq.a: No. Each product photo is its own job. Start the next product when you are ready.

benefits_h2: A product reveal video before the item ships

benefits.t: Show a first look while production finishes
benefits.d: Start from a sample photo so the first look exists before the full run is packed. You do not need a studio day to get that first visual out.
benefits.alt: Adult hand lifts a fabric cover from a plain desk lamp in warm window light.

benefits.t: Reveal the product without printing the date
benefits.d: The scene can show the item coming out of the box. The launch date, the name, and the price stay in your editor until they are confirmed.
benefits.alt: Adult hands reveal a plain kraft product pouch from an opened shipping box.

benefits.t: Move launch day without remaking the scene
benefits.d: When the day changes, edit the text on the file you already downloaded. The product scene stays put.
benefits.alt: Adult hands arrange a natural canvas tote beside a blank planning card on a sunny desk.

benefits.t: Show the first use, then post it
benefits.d: A hand using the product is enough for the launch post. Keep the clip on that one action so the item stays easy to recognize.
